Question: What date is 199 days after 2024-08-30?
Answer: 2025-03-17

Calculation: 2024-08-30 is day-of-year 243 in leap year 2024. +199 = day 442. 2024 has 366 days, so 442-366=76. Day 76 of 2025 (non-leap) is March 17.
